name: Confluence
description: Confluence is Atlassian's workspace for team documentation and shared knowledge. Teams create pages, databases, and whiteboards, organize them into spaces, collaborate through comments, and connect documentation to project work.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Confluence Cloud site through Relay-owned Atlassian OAuth, then let agents read, maintain, or administer its authorized content under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read Confluence
capabilities.description: Read and search the selected site's spaces, content, users, and metadata.

capabilities.label: Manage Confluence
capabilities.description: Create, update, upload, archive, and delete authorized site content.

capabilities.label: Administer Confluence
capabilities.description: Manage authorized configuration, permissions, groups, and audit resources.

allowed.label: Read Confluence
allowed.description: Read and search content in the connected Confluence site.

approvalRequired.label: Change Confluence
approvalRequired.description: Create, update, upload, archive, or delete content in the connected site.

approvalRequired.label: Administer Confluence
approvalRequired.description: Use the selected account's authorized Confluence administration APIs.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: OAuth credentials never enter agent-visible requests or results.

blocked.label: Access another Confluence site
blocked.description: Every request remains pinned to the Confluence Cloud site selected during sign-in.

blocked.label: Call an unsupported API
blocked.description: Relay permits only documented Confluence Cloud REST v2 and legacy v1 routes.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds queries, uploads, request bodies, responses, redirects, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Reads run directly; every write, delete, upload, or administrative request requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected, provider-authorized Confluence action runs without Relay per-action approval; site binding, ownership, selected capabilities, bounds, audits, secret non-exposure, and Atlassian authorization still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts site-bound Confluence REST tools and attaches refreshed OAuth tokens server-side.
Railway mounts site-bound Confluence REST tools and attaches refreshed OAuth tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's Atlassian developer-console OAuth 2.0 integration and Railway Confluence client credentials are not configured yet.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create or update the Relay Console Atlassian 3LO integration, add the manifest's Confluence scopes, enable resource-level grants and sharing, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/confluence/callback, store CONFLUENCE_CLIENT_ID and CONFLUENCE_CLIENT_SECRET in Railway, deploy, and run live connect, read, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation, refresh, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial checks.

evidence.supports: Atlassian presents Confluence as a shared knowledge workspace built around pages, spaces, databases, whiteboards, collaboration, and connected project work.
Atlassian documents one distributable OAuth 2.0 app, exact callbacks, resource-level grants, accessible-resources site discovery, cloud-ID routing, sharing, and rotating offline refresh tokens.
Confluence Cloud REST v2 is the current API for attachments, pages, spaces, comments, databases, folders, whiteboards, permissions, and related resources, with cursor pagination.
Atlassian publishes Confluence OAuth scopes and recommends classic scopes where available while retaining Confluence user permissions.
Atlassian documents Confluence Cloud rate limiting and retry behavior; Relay maps throttling to a provider-safe rate-limit error.
